items.question: Does Slate read my entire Obsidian vault?
items.answer: No. Slate only indexes the folders you choose and keeps everything on-device for speed and privacy.

items.question: When will the iPhone and iPad versions launch?
items.answer: We are shipping the alpha first. Join the early access list on the homepage to be notified as soon as builds are ready.

items.question: How do I link this FAQ inside the app?
items.answer: Point your Support or FAQ button to https://slatetasks.com/support/#faq for a direct jump to these questions.
